column6: @q{“…… beloved sister of @wDN{Dumuzid}, beloved …… of @wDN{Durtur}, …… seed implanted into the womb by a good bull, my lady, born to ladyship! With her aid the cattle-pen was filled with butter and cream, with her aid the sheepfold was long provided with milk. On the high plain, my ……, you are @wDN{Ŋeštin-ana}. O girl, …… indeed! Your little ones …… indeed! @wSN{Unug} …… indeed! @wSN{Kulaba} …… indeed! …… you are …….”}

Because of her brother, the girl lacerated her eyes and lacerated her mouth; she lacerated her buttocks, the place not spoken of to men. She made her way towards the tavern of the palace. The girl questioned a minister who was coming out of the palace.

The minister who was coming out of the palace answered the girl: @q[minister,girl]{“Those endowed with divine powers, 10 incantation priests, prostration priests, bathed priests and ablution priests will never cease coming every month, once a month, to the great shrine, for your brother, who has taken possession of the @fsux{en} priesthood, the @fsux{en} priesthood of @wSN{Unug} ……, for your brother, who has taken possession of the @fsux{en} priesthood.”}

At that time there were seven, there were seven, the song performers of @wSN{Unug} were seven; in @wSN{Zabalam} the lament singers were fifty. They knew the stars of the heavens, and they knew the roads of the earth. In the broad heavens, they carried the first-fruit offerings. They raised songs, and they lowered songs; they did not declare the beginning of the song to them. They were elders not yet assigned to their positions.

The little sister dwelling among them spoke to them @gap{1 line unclear} @q{“While we raise the song, you will lower the song.”} …… she did not dwell among them ……. She dwelt in the …… of the @fsux{eršema}. She dwelt …… the @fsux{eršema}, of precious metal and lapis lazuli, of the goldsmith.
